summary: Corteva and subsidiary EIDP disclosed that Vylor Inc. completed private exchange offers and consent solicitations for any and all outstanding EIDP senior notes, exchanged into new Vylor notes, with accepted EIDP notes retired and canceled at the October 1, 2026 settlement. A Fourth EIDP Supplemental Indenture implements the proposed amendments, modifying security-holder rights under Item 3.03. No price per share, premium, board recommendation, advisor, or regulatory clock is stated. Watch final acceptance amounts, remaining EIDP note overhang, and any rating or covenant consequences from the new Vylor structure.
